runtime: Repository-pinned Bun 1.4.2; separate disposable PostgreSQL databases per investigation

before: JSON strings false/null/true fell through into plain successful IDs
Null MCP envelopes and metadata-only records could confirm a send
Partial SMTP acceptance was described as the entire reviewed message sent
fix: Separate JSON parsing errors from recursive decoding failures, retaining opaque/digit/exponent-like IDs
Validate MCP envelope types and reject metadata-only records
Email uses known Gmail/SMTP confirmation shapes; SMTP must accept all reviewed To/Cc recipients with no rejects
Managed Slack keeps opaque reply compatibility because its remote success schema was not verified
investigations.checks: Six permanent decoder tests; 27 live/recovered service scenarios in the main integration matrix; eight additional subagent diagnostic cases are not counted again.

before: Confirmed transport completion after retirement rolled settlement back, leaving sending
Discard could create queued work after retirement had taken its cancellation snapshot
fix: Settlement and mutation acquire lifecycle before card/notification locks
Known outcomes persist after retirement without waking an archived bot/channel
Settlement-first wakes are included in the retirement cancellation snapshot
investigations.checks: Four permanent database cases /64 assertions; archive-first, settlement-first and a discard waiting behind archive. Storage phase is simulated; no real cleanup or runtime calls.

before: Pending fields stayed stale after another device saved edits, and submitting silently overwrote those edits
A late Pending HTTP response restored Send/Discard after a Sent prop update
iOS source handling could retain a lost-response error beside a confirmed discard
fix: Merge incoming pristine fields while retaining dirty local edits
Keep terminal state/history authoritative over late replies
Suppress iOS errors after confirmed Sent/Discarded and clear stale local sending state
Keep desktop Check delivery available when a successful refresh still reports Sending
investigations.checks: Permanent client reconciliation/state tests, actual-component hook reproductions, native desktop smoke test; Swift syntax passes, full iOS build does not.

before: A new run reusing a call ID received an earlier run card as its own receipt
Legacy account binding accepted unrelated, send-action or failed tool receipts as verification
fix: Recovered creation receipts must belong to the same bot and run
Legacy binding requires exact verification call identity, appropriate tool/action, and successful verification-shaped result
investigations.checks: Cross-run refusal and non-verification/missing-identity scenarios; current and verified legacy routes still pass.
